# NEAR gas and fees, 90-day economics backfill (20261112T2208Z)

Requirements: final_master_prompt s7; Build Bible ch.06, ch.07; D10, D11, S15. Owner approval 2026-11-13 ("I allowed 90 day backfill", ADR-20261112-001). Worker A36.

## Approval and guards

- Plan: A24 lean design only (`outcomes`, `conversion`, `gas_price`), one job per (day, family), newest day first; window 2026-08-12..2026-11-02 (83 days) + the 7 pilot days 2026-11-03..09 already loaded = 90 days.
- Digest `7f25a2bd2c66b3a76e7cce3134bfe34c1df5b4e6ef2d4d3c88197497aefce5bf` (recorded before the run in `docs/economics/APPROVAL-90d-backfill.md`); approvedMaxBytes 22548578304 (21 GiB).
- Free dry-run total before billing: 20288112640 B (18.89 GiB) <= 21 GiB. Guards used: digest and approvedMaxBytes check, cumulative ceiling (each job counted at its 10 MiB minimum), per-job maximumBytesBilled (1.1 x estimate, never below 10 MiB), 95 GiB daily quota ledger. No guard refused; nothing skipped; no retries.
- Billed before the run in quota day 2026-11-12: 40201355264 B (37.44 GiB); all 249 jobs ran in that one quota day.

Billed 21052260352 B = 19.61 GiB, 93.4% of the 21 GiB approval. gas_price jobs bill the 10 MiB per-job minimum (83 x 10,485,760 B), which is why billed exceeds the dry-run total. USD uses the list price of 6.25 per TiB, no free tier assumed (an upper bound, not an invoice). Largest job: outcomes:2026-10-11 (the receipt-heavy burst day).

## Coverage and gaps (ClickHouse `nearesis_live`, after the load; pilot days included)

- `near_economics_outcomes_daily` 68,910 rows, `near_economics_conversion_daily` 8,661 rows, `near_economics_gas_price_daily` 90 rows; each covers 90 distinct days 2026-08-12..2026-11-09.
- `source_coverage`: 90 days `complete` for each of the three datasets; no `partial` or `unavailable` day (no PROVIDER_GAP, no fractional-gas, null-field or odd-price gap).
- `quality_gaps` (standing, by design, one per day): `REFUND_SPLIT_IS_PROXY` (partial) and `REFUND_VALUE_NOT_DERIVED` (partial) on outcomes. Fees are never labelled protocol revenue; token values keep the `source_float64` precision tag.

## Reconciliation (same checks as the pilot, run on every one of the 83 new days)

1. Outcomes contain the transaction conversion burn (`reconcileLeanToConversion`: gas >= conversion gas, tokens >= conversion tokens, outcomes >= transactions, outcomes present): **83 of 83 days OK**, 0 failures. Per-day figures are in the result file.
2. Gas price inside the protocol range 1e8..2e9 yocto/gas and min <= mean <= max: **83 of 83 days OK**.
3. Per-receiver conversion rows (named + folded) sum to the day row (txs, gas, tokens): **83 of 83 days OK** (also enforced by the loader).
4. Lean vs full-join refund proxy (`compareLeanToFull`) needs the A18 receipt_details join, which costs 0.54 GiB per day; it was run on the pilot reference day 2026-11-03 only (gas, tokens, outcomes equal; refund proxy exact) and was NOT re-run on the 83 backfill days (that would be an unapproved extra spend). The proxy is therefore validated on one day.
5. Implied receipt-only token burn (outcomes - conversion) is positive on all 83 days; transactions per day 502649..1217209, outcomes per day 2604872..27648520.
